description: This is a shell script responsible for managing the forwarding service, including starting, stopping, and restarting network forwarding components such as LAN, WAN, and bridge interfaces. It contains functions to handle networking modes, conditionally restarts services, and logs status updates.

methods.name: router_mode
methods.description: Handles specific actions for Raspberry Pi boards, restarting hostapd processes after stopping LAN interfaces.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Manages the startup process of the forwarding service, including network mode determination, stopping conflicting services, and starting necessary network components based on configuration.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Handles stopping the forwarding service, ensuring network components are halted properly.
